## What it is
rag-shared is a shared utilities library for RAG orchestration services.
It provides readable logging, OpenTelemetry observability (optional), and a Dragonfly/Redis client for inter-service data sharing.

## Current capabilities
- Readable Logging (Milvus-style format)
- OpenTelemetry Observability (optional)
- Dragonfly/Redis Client
